invariants.rationale: The method is expected to return a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object after a clustering operation, barring exceptional or abnormal execution.
The returned result should always be of type HoodieWriteMetadata since that is the static return type of the method.
clusteringInstantTime is a required parameter for clustering and is passed directly to the underlying action executor.
context is a required engine context and is used directly in the operation, so should not be null.
